messages:
nina: Heads up — Ellenora's March invoice (acct: ELL-992) missing the reserved commitment credit lines; total is ~ $14k higher than expected. Looks like prorate logic flipped and applied an offset to the support fee instead.

mike: Can you paste the invoice id / PDF preview? DM or link is fine.

nina: invoice id  INV-2026-03-1177. Preview: https://invoices.redwood.internal/INV-2026-03-1177 (internal only). Quick excerpt:
```
Line 1: Hosted API usage - $28,342.00
Line 2: Support fee (prorated) - -$1,200.00  <-- unexpected negative here
Line 3: Reserved commitment credit - MISSING
Line 4: Taxes - $2,100.00
Subtotal: $29,242.00
```

mike: billing-bot just posted a failure for the generator job last night? @billing-bot what did the pipeline log show?

billing-bot: invoice-generator-job/367 failed at 2026-03-20T02:14Z: commit-match error: no active commitment found for account_id=ELL-992 (commitment_lookup returned empty). Fallback to prorate path executed.

nina: yeah that fallback path subtracts a prorated support offset when it can't find a commitment record. It should instead create a placeholder credit line and flag for manual review.

mike: quick check: did the commitments table show a recent contract update? (sounds like a contract id mismatch)

nina: running query now:
```
SELECT id, account_id, committed_gpu_hours, start_date, end_date FROM commitments WHERE account_id='ELL-992' ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 3;
-- returns a row with commitment_id CMT-481 but start_date=2026-04-01 (future), previous commit expired 2026-02-28
```

elaine: so they had a commitment that expired end of Feb and a renewal scheduled for Apr 1 — there is a one-month gap in March. Did we mean to pro-rate for that gap? Probably not; sales applied a credit on renewal.

mike: that explains missing credit. But we still sent an invoice without any note — that's bad. We need to reissue with a credit line for the renewal-prorate and ensure total equals what the account expects.

sre-oncall: alert: reissuing can trigger duplicate payment attempts if customers already paid the old PDF. Make sure we mark original invoice as "superseded" and add a credit memo rather than voiding.

elaine: Finance decision: approve reissue if we add a clear note and create a credit memo. Don't auto-refund — operations team to handle settlement if payment already applied. @mike please add a comment explaining the contract gap.

mike: Copy. Plan: 1) run invoice-generator in dry-run with override to inject placeholder commitment credit line for INV-2026-03-1177 2) produce new PDF (INV-2026-03-1177-R1) 3) create credit memo referencing original invoice and update accounting export 4) hold auto-send until finance signs off.

nina: I'll run the dry-run and paste the diff here.

billing-bot: dry-run completed by nina at 2026-03-20T03:02Z. Diff attached: removed unexpected negative support offset, added commitment prorate credit -$9,600. New total: $19,642.00.

elaine: Approved. Please include mandatory comment: "Reissue due to commitment renewal gap; original invoice superseded. No automatic refunds without finance approval."

mike: Roger. @sre-oncall can you put a temporary suppress-send tag on the mailer for customer ELL-992 until we confirm?

sre-oncall: suppressed outbound for ELL-992 for invoices with prefix INV-2026-03; will lift after confirmation.

mike: Thanks. I'll follow up with accounting to ensure we don't double-book revenue. Expect reissue draft in ~30m.

nina: draft posted: https://invoices.redwood.internal/drafts/INV-2026-03-1177-R1 — pls review. Short note added to PDF per finance.

elaine: reviewed + :thumbsup: — proceed to create credit memo and final R1. Leave audit comment in Stripe export.

mike: done. Credit memo CM-2026-03-88 created, final R1 queued but not auto-sent. Closing the thread once email goes out.

nina: thanks everyone. Filing a follow-up ticket to change fallback behavior (create placeholder credit line + flag) — will add to next sprint.

mike: filing ticket: BILL-846 "invoice fallback should create placeholder credit and flag for manual review". ETA sprint 42.

elaine: perfect. Closing from finance side when R1 is sent and accounting confirms no duplicate charge.

mike: R1 sent at 2026-03-20T03:42Z. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
